bio.text: KathleenMae Rogers is running as an independent write-in candidate for Missouri's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
She is a Marine Corps veteran and a graduate student whose research focuses on treatment of and access to treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder; she has not held public office.

sources.title: Missouri 4th District election guide: Alford, Herrera, Holbrook and Rogers
